text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Hosted API p99 latency > 12s and queue length growth observed across us-east-1 host-queue. GPU pool 'hotpath-us-east' at 98% memory and 100% active slots. Autoscaler attempted 3 scale-ups in last 7m and failed (quota/timeout).

jack: seeing cascading 503s at the edge and timeouts from several customers. p95 jumped from 300ms to ~2.1s, p99 to 12s. Queue backlog ~18k pending requests and climbing.

lina: thanks — I'm oncall. starting checklist. assigning severity P1. tagging eng-runtime & eng-provisioner.

eng-runtime: grabbing logs now. initial error looks like: `provisioner.create_node: rpc deadline exceeded` repeated, then `quota exceeded: gpu_instances` for two attempts. Also some `kv-cache miss` spam which is inflating token work.

eng-provisioner: confirmed, cloud provider returned 429/403 for quota requests, our retry window hit backoff. Provisioner leader tried fallback pool but annotations blocked by placement constraints (affinity: hotpath). Currently can't spawn more from the thin pool.

ops-lead: rolling manual mitigation options — 1) enable fallback routing to lower-capacity model-variants (cpu/quantized) for non-high-priority routes, 2) increase hosted throttle for noisy tenants, 3) manually de-prioritize background jobs.

product-support: we have 2 enterprise customers with active live traffic in affected region (cust-A, cust-B). Cust-A reports request failures. Raising CS heads.

sre-oncall: I'll open proxy throttle window ASAP. Lina — do you want me to flip the `hosted.edge.shed_threshold` to 0.8?

lina: yes, set to 0.75. prefer conservative shed early. also enable `fallback-to-quant` for route `/v1/generate` for non-authenticated keys.

eng-runtime: pushing config now:```
# temp runtime overrides
hosted.edge.shed_threshold=0.75
routes./v1/generate.fallback_variant=quantized-medium
routes./v1/generate.priority_filter=enterprise_only
```

eng-provisioner: manual work: starting warm-burst on reserved-dedicated pool (reserved-us-east), moving lower-priority jobs off hotpath. kicking off node replacement for 6 nodes (estimated ready ~6-8m). Cloud request still shows quota limit for 2 new GPUs, but reserved pool has spare capacity.

jack: can we route lower-priority traffic to reserved-us-east? will there be network/AZ mismatch?

eng-provisioner: routing possible via a route override, won't be in same AZ but that's fine for latency-sensitive traffic if we prioritize. making routing change: `route-policy hotpath -> reserved-us-east` for route groups with `priority != enterprise`.

incident-bot: NOTE: manual mitigation 'route-override' applied by eng-provisioner at ts=4300001250.

product-support: Cust-A notified: "temporary degraded performance, failing over to quantized variant, engineering investigating." Cust-B pinged for heads-up.

customer-ops-bot: Customer Impact Summary: impacted requests 0.9% of global traffic but ~12% of p99 contributors; affected features: chat completions and long-context batch generation.

lina: update: shed threshold and fallback applied. queue stopped growing within 2m and started to drain slowly. p95 back to ~600ms, p99 down to ~4.2s. still high but improving.

eng-runtime: node replacements progressing. 4/6 warm nodes online. autoscaler still logs `quota exceeded` on scale requests. Need cloud quota increase request to avoid recurrence.

ops-lead: filing urgent quota increase with provider now. ticket created: https://cloud.example.com/cases/INC-98765 (internal ref). ETA unknown but engineering cannot rely on quota until approved.

jack: what else? can we evict/kill any long-running KV-cache-heavy requests to speed drain?

eng-runtime: yes — adding ephemeral eviction for jobs older than 45s and non-enterprise tags. applying: `queue.eviction.max_age=45s` and `queue.eviction.priority_cutoff=standard`.

eng-provisioner: routing override completed. reserved pool is handling ~30% of current backlog now. drain rate improving.

product-support: CS updated both customers and offered credits for failure window 4300001234-4300001290. they're accepting and asked for postmortem.

lina: assigning postmortem owners: eng-runtime + eng-provisioner + ops-lead. include root cause: autoscaler retries + cloud quota exhaustion + affinity constraints. action items: request quota raise, add auto-fallback policy to reserved pools on provider-quota errors, and add preemptive shed triggers when kv-cache miss rate > 20%.

sre-oncall: adding runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/hosted-queue-backlog.md — follow for triage steps and retrospective checklist.

eng-runtime: quick note on logs for postmortem: attaching snippet for correlating requests ->```
[4300001247] provisioner.create_node -> rpc deadline exceeded
[4300001248] cloud: quota exceeded: gpu_instances
[4300001251] runtime: route-override applied
[4300001253] queue.length: 18,720 -> 12,430 (after overrides)
[4300001266] p99: 12.1s -> 4.3s
```

ops-lead: closing incident provisional. will keep monitoring until queue drains below 500. Lina please stay on until handoff in 30m.

lina: staying. thanks everyone. summary will be posted to #postmortems and I'll start the doc now. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed (provisional): severity=P1, duration=~10m, mitigations applied: route-override, fallback-to-quant, shed-threshold, reserved-pool routing. Postmortem owners: eng-runtime, eng-provisioner, ops-lead.

jack: thanks all. lessons: pre-authorize quota bump for emergency, loosen placement affinity for thin pool to accept hotpath overflow, and add automated fallback on quota errors.

product-support: flagging for account management review for impacted customers.

lina: will schedule follow-up retrospective. end of thread."
